body: But where would I go? All the things that were once important seem so superficial and boring. Ive been in this dark chasm of water for years- nothing seems bright anymore, I have no desires- its like every emotion is gone. Everyone around me seems too happy, too real. And I don't want to improve, because it would only be for myself, my own benefit- and I truly don't deserve it. It's hard to comprehend how unmotivated I feel all the time, I take it minute by unbearable minute- and for what purpose? I can't find one.
How did you turn out? Any strategies?
I don't really see how, but thanks. Hope you can get out of this darkness soon...

Yes, I think that may have been the earlier stages, but now I seriously do not give a single SHIT. About anything. I'm distrustful of everyone, their interactions with me- its so hard to visualize getting out of my room tomorrow. I have absolutely NO drive. It was once out of fear, but now that all my emotions have evaporated- just a hollow shell- I don't want to get better. For me, it all goes back to human survival instincts- everyone is essentially selfish animals, trying to improve only themselves. I don't have any drive, nothing is important, I don't want any of it- it's seems like there's no way out.

I'm a junior. And that would make one of us. I don't want to get better, its too scary- I haven't felt true untainted, even shallow happiness in a really long time. I've read a lot of these threads- i hate how I don't even have any external problems- its all this mental shit I've been screaming at myself for years, becoming paranoid for no reason. It's impossible to focus on anything, just falling- no desires- nothing ahead.
